title: Second Battle of Cawnpore
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Second Battle of Cawnpore", at revision 1370736006, opens: "The Second Battle of Cawnpore was a battle of Indian Rebellion of 1857 that was decisive by thwarting the rebels' last chance to regain the initiative and to recapture the cities of Cawnpore and Lucknow." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4212577, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle during Indian rebellion of 1857 at kanpur". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
